constraints.text: Requests with blocked topics are rejected
Requests that are too short or vague are rejected
A blocked request ends the run instead of continuing
The itinerary must contain the required fields
The itinerary total cost must not exceed the budget
The itinerary must not include excluded activities
The itinerary must not contain personal data (phone or email)
An over-budget or unapproved itinerary is regenerated up to a retry limit
